topic: Can geometric programming methods maintain scalability for power allocation in dense multiband satellite networks?
response: Yes, geometric programming methods can maintain scalability for power allocation in dense multiband satellite networks. This is because they are based on convex optimization and can efficiently handle large-scale problems with multiple variables and constraints.
reference_context: The reference context mentions the use of geometric programming and successive convex approximation approaches for power allocation in uplink multiband satellite communications systems (Source: power-allocation-for-uplink-multiband-satellite-communications-with-nonlinear-impairments.txt, P.?).
